decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing house on the site

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 04/06/2014 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling on this site and shall not be occupied as primary residential accommodation or as a separate dwelling or for business use.
description: Erection of an outbuilding in rear garden for use as gym
